title: KioskSettingsProfile
description: Single source of truth for a kiosk settings profile's configJson shape. Backend zod validation (backend/src/routes/admin.profiles.routes.ts) and the Android DataStore profile mirror (android .../data/SettingsProfile.kt) must both match this shape.

mode.description: Whether the kiosk shows a locked WebView (web) or launches+pins another installed app (native_app).

url.description: Home URL loaded in web mode.

urlWhitelist.description: Glob/domain patterns allowed to navigate to; empty = allow all except blacklist.

sleepTime.description: 24h HH:mm, screen locks via dpm.lockNow() at this time daily.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of no touch input before the screensaver overlay shows. null disables it.

screenshotIntervalMinutes.description: null disables periodic screenshots; on-demand REQUEST_SCREENSHOT command still works.

pinHash.description: Salted hash of the local exit/settings PIN. Set by the device on first PIN configuration, not by the admin.
